purpose: G3v ceiling pre-check on OLD data only (retrospective). Decides whether the formal test may lack discriminating power. Not the formal 8-group result.
data: The 64 Gate 2 candidate patches: 256 m squares on a 2 m grid (data/processed/candidates/*.npy, from USGS 3DEP 1 m). Window differs from the formal design (256 m vs 1.92 km).
units: Each old patch is one unit (pre-check only; no site grouping applied).
pseudo_groups: numpy default_rng(20261114).permutation of the 64 patch names (sorted); first 24 form 8 pseudo-groups of 3 targets in order; remaining 40 form the site pool.
random_reference: For each pseudo-group: 200 random 3-site combinations from the 40-site pool, drawn with default_rng(20261114 + group_index), each a sample of 3 distinct sites.
slope: Per-pixel slope (deg) on the 2 m grid by central differences (src/fingerprint.slope_deg); valid = finite slope.
provides_rule: A site provides a bin if >= 5% of its valid 2 m area falls in that bin.
coverage: Group coverage = share of the 3 targets' pooled valid 2 m area whose bin is provided by >= 1 selected site (pooled pixel counts = weighting by target valid area).
stop_rule: If >= 7 of 8 pseudo-groups have random-coverage median >= 95%: stop G3v and record exactly: 'Old-data pre-check indicates the test may lack discriminating power; the formal new holdout acceptance was not run; result: INCONCLUSIVE.'
